{{Current events|year=2019|month=04|day=15|content=

<!-- All news items below this line -->
;Arts and culture
*[[2019 Pulitzer Prize]]
**[[Annapolis, Maryland]] daily newspaper ''[[The Capital]]'' is awarded a [[Pulitzer Prize]] for its coverage of a [[Capital Gazette shooting|mass shooting inside its own offices]] on June 28, 2018, that left five of its employees dead. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-us-canada-47943562 (BBC)]

;Business and economy
*[[AT&T|AT&T Inc.]] sells its 10% stake in [[Hulu]] to Hulu LLC for $1.43 billion. [https://variety.com/2019/digital/news/hulu-acquires-att-stake-1-43-billion-1203190132/ (Variety)]

;Disasters and accidents
*[[Notre-Dame de Paris fire]]
**A fire breaks out at the [[Notre-Dame de Paris]] cathedral in [[Paris]], resulting in the collapse of its roof and [[spire]] and considerable damage to the building's interior. [https://www.ajc.com/news/national/fire-reported-paris-notre-dame-cathedral/ukKe051QWt0d21wFgEhWbP/ (AJC)] [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-europe-47941794 (BBC)]
**[[President of the French Republic|French President]] [[Emmanuel Macron]] pledges to rebuild the Cathedral after the fire. [https://www.bbc.com/news/amp/world-europe-47943705 (BBC)]

;International relations 
*[[Inter-Korean summits]], [[North Korea–South Korea relations]]
**[[President of South Korea|South Korean President]] [[Moon Jae-in]] says he is ready for a fourth summit with [[List of leaders of North Korea|North Korean leader]] [[Kim Jong-un]]. The [[2019 inter-Korean summit]] will be held in South Korean capital of [[Seoul]]. [http://time.com/5570629/south-north-korea-summit-moon-kim/ (Time)] [https://www.sfgate.com/news/world/amp/South-Korean-president-calls-for-4th-summit-with-13767486.php (SFGate)]

;Law and crime
*Four people are killed in a string of shootings in [[Penticton]], [[British Columbia]], in what police are calling targeted killings. A man later turned himself in and was taken into custody. [https://www.cbc.ca/news/canada/british-columbia/police-penticton-residents-stay-inside-serious-incident-1.5098815 (CBC News)]

;Politics and elections 
*[[2020 United States presidential election]], [[2020 Republican Party presidential primaries]], [[Bill Weld 2020 presidential campaign]]
**Former [[Governor of Massachusetts|Massachusetts Governor]] [[Bill Weld]] announces he is running for the [[Republican Party (United States)|Republican Party's]] nomination to be [[President of the United States]] in the 2020 presidential election, the first Republican to officially challenge incumbent [[Presidency of Donald Trump|President]] [[Donald Trump]]. [https://www.cnn.com/2019/04/15/politics/bill-weld-2020-trump/index.html (CNN)]
